intro: A dying empress, three princes circling the throne, and a stranger nobody in the palace takes seriously. The hook lands fast: one moment the court dismisses Celeste, the next the empress is on her knees in front of her. It is a palace drama built on one question, and the show is smart about how slowly it answers it.
why: An opening twist that flips the power balance within the first episodes.
Royal scheming between three brothers, with enough suspicion to keep every scene tense.
A calm, underestimated heroine whose real identity is the mystery that keeps you watching.
Good pick if you like palace intrigue with a touch of the supernatural instead of pure romance.
